notes: Version 36.4 puts your PC's service on the Home screen, adds a Temperatures page that watches your graphics cards all the time, and checks Windows' start-up partition before the next big update - the full service now tidies it when it's too full. Home now lists what needs doing most urgently first, and a healthy PC simply says All good. Bigger text works on every screen, Get help shows when we answer the phone, turning off start-up programs is free, and Clear junk files & report no longer empties the Recycle Bin. Techies One - email, letters, sums and files - has its own place on the menu, the music light show is rebuilt - twelve scenes that move in time with the music, with moods, colours and settings you can change, including Liquid, which you can stir with the mouse - and it moves to anything your PC plays, and the text is a little bigger and clearer throughout. There's an About page too - who makes the app, how it's tested and what's new in each version. Signed by 365 Techies Ltd.
